intro.summary: St. André Bessette was a Canadian Holy Cross brother known for humble service at Saint Joseph’s Oratory and devotion to St. Joseph.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St. Andre Bessette Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: expanded canonical prayer references into full rosary texts; Standardized “St” to “Saint” and added commas in the opening prayer for clearer text-to-speech pacing.; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; reused compacted prayer source from an earlier section; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Lord, you have chosen Brother André to spread devotion to Saint Joseph, and to dedicate himself to all those who are poor and afflicted. Grant, through his intercession, the favor that we now request

Grant us the grace to imitate his piety and charity, so that, with him, we may share the reward promised to all who care for their neighbors out of love for you. We make this prayer in the Name of Jesus the Lord. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saint André Bessette, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
